name: xrblocks
description: XR Blocks is a lightweight WebXR + AI library for rapidly prototyping advanced AI + XR experiences.

paragraphs: XR Blocks is a lightweight, cross-platform library for rapidly prototyping advanced XR and AI experiences. Built upon three.js, it targets Chrome v136+ with WebXR support on Android XR (e.g., Galaxy XR, XREAL Aura) and also includes a powerful desktop simulator for development.
